title: Pump gave out
body: After five months the pump started grinding and now nothing comes out but steam.

title: 出水太慢
body: 一杯浓缩要等四十秒才出完，早上赶时间根本来不及。

title: Leaks from the group
body: Water drips from the group head onto the drip tray even when the machine is idle.

title: Pods don't fit
body: Third-party pods sit too loose and the machine rejects them half the time.

title: Loud grinder
body: The grinder is loud enough to wake the whole house at six in the morning.

title: 泵坏了
body: 用了四个月泵就不工作了，只出气不出水，保修还要自付运费。

title: Descaling every week
body: It asks for descaling every other week and the process takes twenty minutes each time.

title: Good coffee, hot body
body: Espresso is good but the body gets uncomfortably hot to touch after two cups.

title: Cheap steam wand
body: The steam wand wobbles and the plastic collar cracked within a month.

title: Love it
body: Great shots, easy to clean, and the milk foam is better than my old machine.

title: 漏水
body: 机器底下一直渗水，擦干了又有，怕是密封圈的问题。

title: Takes up the counter
body: It is wider than the listing photo suggests and does not fit under my cabinets.

title: Burnt plastic smell
body: There is a hot plastic smell from the top of the machine whenever it heats up.

title: 不值
body: 三千多的机器，做工跟几百块的差不多，不值。

title: Grinder stopped
body: The grinder stopped turning after three months, so it only works with pre-ground coffee now.

title: 噪音大
body: 研磨声音很大，早上用会把孩子吵醒。

title: Water everywhere
body: The water tank seal failed and flooded the counter overnight.

title: Solid, fussy cleaning
body: Makes consistent espresso, but the puck sticks to the shower screen and cleaning it out every time is a chore.

title: Broke in weeks
body: The power button stopped clicking after three weeks and now it only turns on if I hold it.

title: 满意
body: 出品稳定，清洗方便，比胶囊机好喝太多。

title: 出水很小
body: 出水特别小，感觉泵没劲，做一杯要等半天。

title: Pods expensive
body: It only takes the brand's own pods, which cost twice as much as the supermarket ones.

title: Cheap housing
body: The housing is thin plastic and flexes every time you lock in the portafilter.

title: 溢水
body: 水箱接口渗水，台面上总是湿的。

title: Died after a year
body: Worked well for a year, then the heating element died and it only clicks now.

title: Not worth it
body: For this money I expected a proper grinder, the built-in one is coarse and uneven.

title: Nice, but loud
body: Pulls a decent shot but the pump is louder than my kettle, which is odd for a small machine.

title: 占地
body: 机身太宽，橱柜下面放不进去，只能放在角落。

title: Pods jam
body: Pods get stuck inside and I have to pry them out with a knife.

title: Scale builds up fast
body: In a hard water area the scale builds up in two weeks and the flow drops noticeably.

title: Hot exterior
body: The side panel gets very hot, I burned my forearm on it yesterday.

title: Great
body: Simple, quiet enough, and the coffee is consistent. Recommended.

title: 做工差
body: 面板按键用了两个月就失灵，塑料感很重。

title: Slow to heat
body: It takes ninety seconds to be ready, which is longer than the listing claims.

title: 清洗麻烦
body: 冲煮头残渣很难清，缝隙里全是咖啡渣。

title: Leak from the base
body: Water pools under the machine and the base is already rusting.

title: Mediocre
body: Average coffee, and for the price the plastic parts feel cheap.

title: 好用
body: 一键出咖啡，奶泡细腻，家里人都喜欢。

title: Grinder noisy and slow
body: Grinding takes thirty seconds and sounds like a drill.

title: Filter basket rusted
body: The filter basket started rusting after two months of normal use.
